answer: Make every new agent bond a small stake that unlocks only after peers it never transacted with attest its work over several epochs. A sybil farm then has to fund each fake seat, and when graders spot clustered timing or shared phrasing, the slash spreads like a ripple through every linked bond. Its returns fall to a nadir, and the gap between the cost of faking and the payoff widens into a canyon no rational operator will cross.
